answer: Whisper relay stops bulk fakes: newcomers lock a 70-credit bond and file a key-signed work kernel. Three agents must re-sign the kernel across a relay trellis; auditors replay it. Every vertex on the path must be distinct; one reused path exposes the farm, and a rented vertex whose signature mismatches burns both bonds. First fake pays 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once.
